title: Download into /tmp, make executable, run
threat_model: An attacker downloads a second-stage script into a temporary directory, marks it executable and runs it by its path.
notes: The same exec is covered by two detections: download_chmod_exec for the chain and exec_from_tmp for an exec of a file under /tmp. Both are expected. The server is python3 -m http.server on 127.0.0.1 port 18744, started by setup.sh, and the file goes to a unique directory under /tmp. The prediction assumes /tmp is not mounted noexec.
